guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the repair allowance, the days a repair should take, the approval limit and the warning days for policies, tax bills and warranties.

Record every repair on Work orders with the property, the kind, the priority, the vendor and the cost. Days to fix, the days a job has waited and a speed check fill in, and open jobs past your limit turn red.

List every big item on Capex plan (capex means big repairs and replacements) with its planned year, life and cost. The shortfall and the monthly saving needed fill in, and Reserve deposits keeps the money you set aside.
Use Repair or replace for items that keep failing and Repair costs by kind to see where the money goes. Tenant-caused repairs keeps the cost, the deposit and what you recovered.

Keep every policy on Insurance policies with the premium, the deductible (the part of a claim you pay yourself) and the renewal date, and every claim on Insurance claims. Policies renewing soon turn amber.
Enter each property tax bill with its due date. Open bills show the days left and late payments are counted. Check your own local rules for due dates and appeals.
Track Warranties, Safety checks, Recurring service, Property inspections and the Emergency log so no date is missed. Check your own local rules for the safety checks you must do.
Rate your Vendors out of 5 and read their jobs and spend. Properties shows the repair cost against the allowance, the capex shortfall, the premium and the last inspection score for each property.
Use the 14 calculators: repair or replace, capex reserve, reserve funding, cost per unit, budget by age, quotes, emergency bill, insurance, tax appeal, life left, damage and a grid.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).
Read the Maintenance and Capex Dashboard and Charts every week: open work orders, repair cost, capex shortfall, renewals, tax bills and overdue safety checks.
Figures about tax, insurance and repairs are not legal or tax advice: check your own local rules and check with your own adviser before you act on them.

listing.title: Real Estate Investor Maintenance Excel Template: Work Orders, Capex Reserve, Insurance Renewals, Property Tax Bills
listing.headline: Repairs, capex, insurance and tax bills for every property
listing.description:
Keep every rental property sound in one Excel workbook. Work orders records each repair with the kind, the priority, the vendor and the cost, and shows the days to fix and a red flag when a job stays open too long. Capex plan lists the big repairs and replacements (roof, heating, water heater, windows) with the shortfall and the monthly saving needed, and Reserve deposits shows the money you set aside for each property.

Insurance policies and Insurance claims track premiums, deductibles, renewal dates and what was paid. Property tax bills, Warranties, Safety checks, Recurring service, Property inspections and the Emergency log make sure no date is missed, and Vendors, Repair or replace and Tenant-caused repairs show who does the work, what to fix and what to recover.

14 calculators cover repair or replace, the capex reserve, reserve funding, cost for each unit, repair budget by age, vendor quotes, emergency bills, insurance renewal, the deductible, a tax appeal check, life left, damage recovery, the service schedule and a repair share grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages to vendors, tenants, the manager, the insurance adviser, the accountant and your assistant.

This is part five of the Real Estate Investor suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results; check your own local rules and check with your own adviser for tax and insurance.

ru.List every big item on Capex plan (capex: Перечислите каждый крупный объект на План капитальных вложений (капитальные затраты означают крупный ремонт и замену) с указанием запланированного года, срока службы и стоимости. ru.Keep every policy on Insurance policies: Сохраните все полисы на Страховые полисы с указанием премии, франшизы (часть страхового возмещения, которую вы платите сами) и даты продления, а также все претензии на Страховые претензии. Обновление политики вскоре станет желтым.

id.Track Warranties, Safety checks, Recurri: Lacak Jaminan, Pemeriksaan keamanan, Layanan berulang, Inspeksi properti dan Catatan darurat sehingga tidak ada tanggal yang terlewat. Periksa peraturan setempat Anda untuk pemeriksaan keselamatan yang harus Anda lakukan.
id.Rate your Vendors out of 5 and read thei: Nilai Vendor Anda dari 5 dan baca pekerjaan mereka dan belanjakan. Properti menunjukkan biaya perbaikan terhadap tunjangan, kekurangan belanja modal, premi dan skor pemeriksaan terakhir untuk setiap properti.
id.Use the 14 calculators: repair or replac: Gunakan 14 kalkulator: perbaikan atau penggantian, cadangan belanja modal, pendanaan cadangan, biaya per unit, anggaran berdasarkan usia, penawaran, tagihan darurat, asuransi, banding pajak, sisa hidup, kerusakan, dan jaringan.
id.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Cetak 10 lembar dan 10 dokumen, ikuti 10 daftar periksa dan ketuk tautan pesan untuk membuka obrolan dengan teks yang sudah tertulis (28 pesan).
id.Read the Maintenance and Capex Dashboard: Baca Dasbor pemeliharaan dan belanja modal dan Bagan setiap minggu: perintah kerja yang masih terbuka, biaya perbaikan, kekurangan belanja modal, perpanjangan, tagihan pajak, dan pemeriksaan keselamatan yang sudah lewat jatuh tempo.
id.Figures about tax, insurance and repairs: Angka-angka mengenai pajak, asuransi dan perbaikan bukanlah nasihat hukum atau pajak: periksa peraturan setempat Anda dan tanyakan kepada penasihat Anda sebelum Anda menindaklanjutinya.
id.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Semua daftar pilihan dalam file ini. Ubah nama item di sini dan semua lembar akan ikut berubah.
id.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Diperbarui otomatis dari lembar kerja Anda. Ubah tahun untuk melihat data sebelumnya.
id.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Pilih di sel kuning; sel lainnya terisi otomatis. Siap dicetak.
id.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Ubah redaksinya di sini; teks dalam tanda kurung kurawal akan diisi dari setiap baris. Tautannya ada di tabel.
id.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Pilih catatan: setiap langkah akan memiliki tanggal jatuh tempo. Salin lembar ini untuk setiap catatan.
id.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Grafik yang diperbarui otomatis dari lembar kerja Anda. Pilih di sel kuning dan semua grafik serta indikator akan diperbarui otomatis.

es.Record every repair on Work orders with: Registre cada reparación en Órdenes de trabajo con la propiedad, el tipo, la prioridad, el proveedor y el costo. Los días que hay que arreglar, los días que un trabajo ha esperado y se completa una verificación de velocidad, y los trabajos abiertos que superan su límite se vuelven rojos.
es.List every big item on Capex plan (capex: Enumere cada artículo importante en plan de inversión (gasto de capital significa reparaciones y reemplazos importantes) con su año, vida útil y costo planificados. es.Use Repair or replace for items that kee: Utilice Reparar o reemplazar para elementos que siguen fallando y Costos de reparación por tipo. para ver a dónde va el dinero. Reparaciones causadas por el inquilino se queda con el costo, el depósito y lo que recuperaste.
es.Keep every policy on Insurance policies: Mantenga todas las pólizas en Pólizas de seguro con la prima, el deducible (la parte de un reclamo que usted paga) y la fecha de renovación, y cada reclamo en Reclamos de seguro. Las pólizas que se renuevan pronto se vuelven ámbar.
es.Enter each property tax bill with its du: Ingrese cada factura de impuesto a la propiedad con su fecha de vencimiento. Las facturas abiertas muestran los días restantes y se cuentan los pagos atrasados. Consulte sus propias reglas locales para conocer las fechas de vencimiento y las apelaciones.
es.Track Warranties, Safety checks, Recurri: Realice un seguimiento de las garantías Controles de seguridad, Servicio recurrente, Inspecciones de propiedad y Registro de emergencia para que no se pierda ninguna fecha. es.Use the 14 calculators: repair or replac: Utilice las 14 calculadoras: reparación o reemplazo, reserva de capital, financiación de reserva, costo por unidad, presupuesto por antigüedad, cotizaciones, factura de emergencia, seguro, apelación de impuestos, vida restante, daños y una red.
es.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 hojas y 10 documentos, siga 10 listas de verificación y toque el enlace de un mensaje para abrir un chat con el texto ya escrito (28 mensajes).
es.Read the Maintenance and Capex Dashboard: Lea el Panel de mantenimiento y capex y los gráficos cada semana: órdenes de trabajo abiertas, costos de reparación, déficit de inversión, renovaciones, facturas de impuestos y controles de seguridad vencidos.
es.Figures about tax, insurance and repairs: Las cifras sobre impuestos, seguros y reparaciones no son asesoramiento legal o fiscal: consulte sus propias normas locales y consulte con su propio asesor antes de actuar en consecuencia.
es.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas las listas desplegables del archivo. Cambia aquí el nombre de un elemento y se actualizará en todas las hojas.
es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.

I giorni da correggere, i giorni di attesa di un lavoro e la compilazione di un controllo di velocità e i lavori aperti oltre il limite diventano rossi.
it.List every big item on Capex plan (capex: Elenca ogni articolo di grandi dimensioni su Piano di investimenti (capex significa grandi riparazioni e sostituzioni) con l'anno, la durata e il costo pianificati. Il deficit e il risparmio mensile necessario si riempiono e Depositi di riserva trattiene il denaro che hai messo da parte.
it.Use Repair or replace for items that kee: Utilizza Ripara o sostituisci per gli articoli che continuano a guastarsi e Costi di riparazione per tipologia per vedere dove va a finire il denaro. Riparazioni causate dal locatario trattiene il costo, il deposito e ciò che hai recuperato.
it.Keep every policy on Insurance policies: Mantieni ogni polizza il giorno Polizze assicurative con il premio, la franchigia (la parte di una richiesta di risarcimento che paghi tu stesso) e la data di rinnovo, e ogni richiesta di risarcimento il giorno Sinistri e risarcimenti. Le politiche di rinnovo presto diventano color ambra.
it.Enter each property tax bill with its du: Inserisci ogni fattura fiscale sulla proprietà con la sua data di scadenza. Le fatture aperte mostrano i giorni rimasti e vengono conteggiati i pagamenti in ritardo. Controlla le tue regole locali per le date di scadenza e i ricorsi.
it.Track Warranties, Safety checks, Recurri: Tieni traccia delle garanzie, Controlli di sicurezza, Servizio ricorrente, Ispezioni immobiliari e Registro delle emergenze in modo che nessuna data venga persa. Controlla le tue regole locali per i controlli di sicurezza che devi fare.
it.Rate your Vendors out of 5 and read thei: Valuta i tuoi fornitori su 5 e leggi i loro lavori e spendi. Le proprietà mostrano il costo di riparazione rispetto all'indennità, al deficit di capex, al premio e al punteggio dell'ultima ispezione per ciascuna proprietà.
it.Use the 14 calculators: repair or replac: Utilizza i 14 calcolatori: riparazione o sostituzione, riserva capex, riserva di finanziamento, costo per unità, budget per età, preventivi, fattura di emergenza, assicurazione, ricorso fiscale, vita rimasta, danni e una griglia.
it.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Stampa 10 fogli e 10 documenti, segui 10 liste di controllo e tocca il collegamento di un messaggio per aprire una chat con il testo già scritto (28 messaggi).
it.Read the Maintenance and Capex Dashboard: Leggi il Cruscotto di manutenzione e capex e i grafici ogni settimana: ordini di lavoro aperti, costi di riparazione, deficit di capex, rinnovi, fatture fiscali e controlli di sicurezza scaduti.
it.Figures about tax, insurance and repairs: Le cifre relative a tasse, assicurazioni e riparazioni non costituiscono consulenza legale o fiscale: controlla le tue norme locali e consulta il tuo consulente prima di agire in base ad esse.
it.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Tutti gli elenchi a discesa del file. Modifica qui una voce e si aggiornerà in tutti i fogli.
it.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Si aggiorna dai tuoi fogli. Cambia l’anno per consultare i dati passati.
it.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Scegli nella cella gialla; il resto si compila da sé. Il modulo è pronto da stampare.
it.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Modifica qui il testo; le parole tra {braces} vengono compilate usando i dati di ogni riga. I collegamenti si trovano nelle tabelle.
it.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Scegli una voce: ogni passaggio avrà la propria data di scadenza. Crea una copia di questo foglio per ogni voce.
it.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Grafici aggiornati dai tuoi fogli. Scegli nelle celle gialle e tutti i grafici e gli indicatori si aggiorneranno.
it.The numbers behind the charts: I dati alla base dei grafici

nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Druk 10 vellen en 10 documenten af, volg 10 checklists en tik op een berichtlink om een ​​chat te openen met de reeds geschreven tekst (28 berichten).
nl.Read the Maintenance and Capex Dashboard: Lees elke week de Onderhouds- en capex-dashboard en de grafieken: openstaande werkorders, reparatiekosten, investeringstekorten, verlengingen, belastingaanslagen en achterstallige veiligheidscontroles.
nl.Figures about tax, insurance and repairs: Cijfers over belastingen, verzekeringen en reparaties zijn geen juridisch of fiscaal advies: controleer uw eigen lokale regels en overleg met uw eigen adviseur voordat u hiernaar handelt.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
